name: m11-remaining
note: The remaining campaign in run order (Evaluation.md 9, revision 3). W0, W1 and W2 (including W2b) are complete and are deliberately not cells here. One cell is one campaign file plus the run count it must expand to. Every cell states the **real** wave size, so a campaign file that is still a placeholder (w3, w4, w5, w6) expands to fewer runs than expected and the runner refuses to start it: replacing a list without updating expect, or running a placeholder, fails loudly instead of spending. Reach a later cell with --from, because --through alone still starts at the first cell and pauses at its stop_after. A stop_after cell is a staged-spend decision point, not a batch boundary: the run stops there unless --through names that cell. checkpoint_usd is the cumulative M11 ceiling from Evaluation.md 10.3.

waves.note: W3 bridge (I1), document mode, mechanism only. 50 instances x 2 arms. The campaign file is still a one-instance placeholder, so this cell expands to 2 and refuses to start: the converter must write the instance file and the per-instance LENS_DOCUMENTS before the count matches. The 10-instance subset at n=3 is its own campaign, not this cell.
W4 doc-needle guardrail (I3). 30 instances x 2 arms. The generator does not exist yet, so the file is a placeholder and this cell refuses to start. H2a is read here.

W5 I5 corpus gold, the in-domain H1 reading. 22 instances x 2 arms. The gold set does not exist yet, so the file is a 3-query placeholder and this cell refuses to start. The 4-instance subset is its own campaign; final-gate calibration runs after the cells.

W5b2 I6 compound on rig v18: the same 7 non-subset instances x 4 arms (A0, A2, A2+Q, A2-R) as the v17 wave, re-run with fetch_paper_chunks so a named paper the funnel misses is reachable. ~$2.3-3.5 at measured rates. Do not pool with w5b-compound (rig v17, pre-tool).

W5b2 subset (cmp-05, cmp-07) at n=3 x 4 arms on rig v18. Run spread versus arm difference, now with the named-paper fetch available; the two instances that were near-unreachable on v17 become the test of the tool.

W6 ablations A3 (depth-0) and A5 (decision layer off). 15 I5 instances x 2 arms. The file is a 5-query placeholder and refuses to start until the I5 instances replace the list. The A2 reference rows are the W5 runs of the same queries, so the file carries no reference arm.
